help.kraPin: Format: A123456789B (1 letter + 9 digits + 1 letter, 11 chars total). Required by KRA for PAYE filing.

help.shifNumber: Social Health Insurance Fund number (replaced NHIF Oct 2024). Format example: CR1620021837701-1.
help.disabilityExemption: Tick if employee has registered disability. They get KSh 150,000/month tax exemption.
